summary: Auth (email+password) + onboarding fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 29/29 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_estimo_auth.py — register (201 with duplicate 409, short password 422, invalid email 422), login (seed OK, wrong password/unknown email both 401 with 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect'), /auth/me (401 without / tampered, OK with seed token), scoping (properties 401 without token, 5 for seed, [] for throwaway, throwaway 404 on seed property, POST/GET/DELETE on throwaway's own property visible only to that account and invisible to seed), PDF report.pdf (401 without token, 200 with Authorization, 200 with ?t=), forgot-password (generic 200 for known+unknown email, http:// origin 422), reset-password with bogus code '000000' -> 400, change-password wrong->400 correct->200 then login with new password works, delete /auth/account wrong password->400 correct->200 then /auth/me->401, public routes /api/health, /api/geocode, /api/dvf/status, /api/models/hedonic, POST /api/estimate/preview still open. Frontend (mobile 390x844): signed-out '/' shows welcome-screen with 3 slides welcome-slide-{estimation,annonce,dossier} and welcome-signup-button/welcome-signin-button; sign-in with wrong password shows signin-screen-error, sign-in with delivered@resend.dev/Estimo2026! lands on home-screen with 20 property cards; home-account-button opens account-screen showing seed email, account-signout returns to welcome-screen; sign-up flow: mismatched confirm shows signup-confirm-error, creating qa-web-<random>@gmail.com/Motdepasse1 lands on home-screen with home-empty-state; account-delete -> account-delete-password -> account-delete-confirm returns to welcome-screen; forgot-password screen shows forgot-screen-success and forgot-goto-reset then reset-screen with reset-code field; session persists on reload; regression signed-in as seed: /property/6aa02db9efd8f90925a5a758 renders estimation '174k€ – 218k€ · Valeur centrale 196 000 €', share-report-button uses api.reportUrl which appends ?t=<token> via withToken() (verified in /app/frontend/src/api.ts:12-15 and 601), /property/6aa02db9efd8f90925a5a758/pack shows pack-unlocked, /data renders 110 213 ventes. Seed account was NOT deleted and its password was NOT changed. Throwaway accounts were cleaned up.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning still emitted at runtime: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Not blocking; pre-existing from iteration 15. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:154-158 fab style.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow (or a web-only shim) to silence the RN-Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/auth.py: Argon2 via pwdlib (recommended preset), JWT HS256 30d, bearer OR ?t= query for PDFs, timing-safe login (dummy hash when user missing), unique email index, TTL index on password_resets.expires_at, migration attributes ownerless docs to first account.

/app/backend/auth.py forgot_password: no user enumeration (same 200 message), max 3 resets per 5 min, origin must be https with non-empty netloc (http rejected 422), sha256-digest of token/code stored, 15-min expiration.
/app/backend/auth.py delete_account: soft-deletes owned business collections then deletes user + resets — matches App Store deletion requirement.
/app/frontend/src/api.ts:12-15 withToken() correctly appends ?t=<encoded token> to PDF/link URLs when a session token is set; used by reportUrl (601), notaireUrl (631), packPdfUrl (638).

/app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx uses expo-router Stack.Protected via SessionProvider to gate authenticated routes (home, property, data, account) — verified visually: unauthenticated '/' renders welcome-screen, authenticated '/' renders home-screen.

AuthShell component wires error/success banners with derived testIDs `${testID}-error` and `${testID}-success` — matches the requested selectors signin-screen-error, signup-screen-error, forgot-screen-success.
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped throwaway account created (qa-estimo-<rand>@gmail.com) and deleted at end of pytest run. change_password_and_delete test creates and destroys its own account. UI test created qa-web-<rand>@gmail.com and deleted it via account-delete flow. Seed account delivered@resend.dev untouched (password unchanged, account not deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is fully working. Reset emails are sent to Resend's sink address delivered@resend.dev so the 6-digit code cannot be read back — only the bogus-code negative path is exercised. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_estimo_auth.py. To recreate a throwaway account for regression: POST /api/auth/register with a gmail.com address (Pydantic EmailStr rejects .test/.example TLDs). PDF URLs work with either Authorization header OR ?t=<token> query.
